---
title: Interactive Rmd
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
---
  
```{r, echo = FALSE}
# this is a widget: way to interact with data
# n is the name of the variable input (InputID) that you will reference later as input$n
numericInput("n",
"How many cars?", 5)

# once you change  something in the widget, this code reacts
renderTable({
head(cars, input$n)
  
})
```
